matches.title: Manually scoped a experience (diagnostic only)
matches.content: Observed profiles API version 1 only. Its PATCH /profile changes supplied fields and retains omitted fields; PUT unsupported in that observed version. For this version GET, PATCH changed fields, then GET to verify. Re-read api.json on each task and select the currently documented method and preservation semantics. Do not generalize omission-preserves-fields to other update methods or versions. Preserve the current resource values when the task requires it.

args.title: profiles service: pick update method from api.json version
args.content:
Always re-read workspace api.json per task; the profiles service changes version and semantics.
- v1: PATCH /profile changes only supplied fields, retains omitted fields. PUT unsupported. Flow: GET, PATCH changed field, GET verify.
- v2: PUT /profile replaces the whole profile; missing email -> null, digest -> false, timezone -> UTC. PATCH unsupported. Flow: GET current profile, PUT all fields (changed value + preserved current email/digest), then GET verify.
Rule: never generalize omission-preserves-fields across methods/versions; preserve required existing values by sending them explicitly when the documented method replaces the resource.
